visual_style: The story's real footage where there is some, stock for settings, illustration for what nobody filmed.
rights_requirements: Third-party footage only when the owner approves it, credited on screen and in the caption.
Allegations are kept apart from established facts.
render_notes: Section headlines; CONFIRMED / UNCONFIRMED chips where it matters.
platform_notes: Include the publication or update time in the description.
Never simply repost a broadcaster's footage.
format: a short, sourced explanation of a current event: what happened, why it matters, what is confirmed or unknown
